case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests frequently praised staff (including Tatiana), spacious comfortable rooms, the pool and other facilities, breakfast variety, and free parking. A few reviewers reported issues such as Wi‑Fi disconnects, damaged beach/pool towels and limited vegetarian options at the buffet; isolated comments mentioned a cold pool and the absence of an indoor pool.

review_summary_metadata.summary_method: Neutral LLM summary of the frozen recent review sample; no additional reviews retrieved.

Conduct a short-term operational and culinary review of dinner service and buffet quality.
Perform a targeted IT and coverage check of hotel Wi‑Fi to locate reported disconnect areas.
Perform an immediate technical check of the wireless network's health and connectivity.
